headline: Brazil Interest Rate Futures Decline on Fiscal Spending Cap Proposal
summary: Brazilian DI interest rate futures fell following news of a proposed constitutional amendment (PEC) to cap government spending growth. Industrial federation CNI warned that fiscal measures shift burden to productive sectors.
why: Brazil's DI futures contracts reflect market expectations for the Banco Central do Brasil's Selic interest rate path.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: DI interest rate futures declined as lawmakers considered fiscal spending limit proposals.
